Convert a pathway bootstrap to a data frame

Source: R/bootstrap.R
as.data.frame.transitiontrees_bootstrap.Rd

as.data.frame() returns the per-pathway summary of a bootstrap_pathways() result, or the values of one statistic in every resample.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'transitiontrees_bootstrap'
as.data.frame(
  x,
  row.names = NULL,
  optional = FALSE,
  what = c("summary", "resamples"),
  stat = c("count", "next_probability", "divergence", "G2", "changes_prediction"),
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A transitiontrees_bootstrap object.

row.names, optional

Ignored.

what

"summary" (default) for one row per pathway, or "resamples" for one row per resample and pathway.

stat

For what = "resamples", the statistic: "count" (default), "next_probability", "divergence", "G2" or "changes_prediction".

...

Ignored.

Value

A data frame. For what = "summary", one row per pathway with the columns described in bootstrap_pathways(). For what = "resamples", one row per resample and pathway with columns resample, pathway, stat and value (NA where the statistic is undefined in that resample).

Conditions

transitiontrees_no_data

(error) what = "resamples" for a bootstrap run with keep_resamples = FALSE.

See also

bootstrap_pathways(), plot_pathway_resamples().

Examples

boot <- bootstrap_pathways(context_tree(trajectories, max_depth = 2),
                           iter = 50)
head(as.data.frame(boot))
